title: Fix curate_curricula/README.md status table: 13 of 14 curricula are marked TODO though main.py already implements them

evidence.quote: | **`mishneh_torah`** | Sefer / Hilchot / Perek / Halacha | NEW — TODO |

why: README.md's Status column marks yerushalmi, mishnayos, chumash, nach, mishna_berurah, mussar, mishneh_torah, shulchan_arukh, arukh_hashulchan, kitzur_shulchan_aruch, chofetz_chaim and sefer_hamitzvot as TODO/'NEW — TODO', but main.py's STRATEGIES dict (lines 592-674) already has a complete, working strategy function for every one of them, plus shemirat_halashon which isn't in the table at all. A contributor or agent trusting this table would either re-implement already-finished strategies or believe the curation tool only covers Bavli.
recommendation: Update the Status column to reflect main.py's STRATEGIES dict (mark implemented curricula done), add the missing shemirat_halashon row, and replace 'TODO' with the tool's actual remaining work (e.g. --diff review / spot-checking against Sefaria taxonomy).
acceptance_criteria: README.md Status column matches every key present in main.py's STRATEGIES dict
No curriculum with a working strategy function is labeled TODO

corrections: AG-8 as literally defined pairs schema/migration→data-models.md, sync-behavior→sync-conflict-resolution.md, collection-shape→firestore-collection-layout.md, new-invariant→coding-standards.md only — it does not cover this README. The 'why' list also omits pirkei_avot from its 12-item enumeration even though the title's '13 of 14' count requires it.
